full_judgment: 4. The applicant in due course submitted it's income tax return for the assessment year 1999-2000 to the concerned Deputy Commissioner Taxes, Company Circle-47, Taxes Zone-5 Dhaka (herein after referred as 'the DCT') initially showing a total tax-free income of Taka 4,74,52,274 (Taka four crores, seventy four lacs, fifty two thousands, two hundreds and seventy four only) and subsequently, the applicant submitted a revised return showing a total loss of Taka 66,10,76,916 (Taka sixty six crores, ten lacs, seventy six thousands, nine hundreds and sixteen only) along with audited annual financial statements and other relevant documents; the applicant also submitted it's return along with audited annual financial statements and necessary documents for the assessment year 2000-2001 to the concerned Deputy Commissioner of Taxes, Company Circle-15, Taxes Zone-5, Dhaka showing a total loss of Taka 105,33,25,808 (Taka one hundred and five crores, thirty three lacs , twenty five thousands, eight hundreds and eight only). The DCT concerned on receiving the said returns issued notices under section 79 and 83(1) of the Ordinance, 1984 and completed the assessment under section 83(2)/44(1)193 of the Ordinance computing a total taxable income of Taka 10,57.28,543 (Ten crores fifty seven lacs twenty eight thousands five hundreds and forty three only) for the assessment year 1999-2000 and also assessed the taxable income of the assessee for the assessment year 2000-2001 at Taka 6,80,23,880 (Taka six crores eighty lacs twenty three thousands eight hundreds and eighty only) under section 83(2)144(1) of the Income Tax Ordinance,1984 rejecting the claim of the asseessee as to the entitlement of exemption.
